objective: Wire the global hotkey to the overlay so a player can show/hide it on demand — overlay/src/hotkey.ts exports registerHotkey and unregisterAll but NOTHING calls them, so the feature is dead code today. In overlay/src/main.ts, register a configurable accelerator (default 'CommandOrControl+Alt+D', overridable via the OVERLAY_HOTKEY env var) that toggles overlay visibility: showInactive() when hidden so game focus is never stolen, hide() when visible. Unregister on will-quit alongside the existing pipeline.stop. Registration failure must be non-fatal — log and continue, since another app may already own the accelerator. Add overlay/test/hotkey.test.ts covering: toggle hidden->shown uses showInactive (never show/focus), shown->hidden calls hide, a failed registration does not throw and leaves the app running, and unregisterAll runs on quit. Mock electron's globalShortcut and BrowserWindow as the existing overlay tests do.

acceptance_criteria.text: A global accelerator (default CommandOrControl+Alt+D, OVERLAY_HOTKEY overrides) toggles the overlay: showInactive() when hidden, hide() when visible.
Showing NEVER steals game focus — show()/focus() are not used on the hotkey path; only showInactive().
A failed hotkey registration is logged and non-fatal; the overlay still runs and the clipboard path is unaffected.
overlay/test/hotkey.test.ts covers toggle-show, toggle-hide, failed registration and unregister-on-quit; the full overlay suite passes.
